title: EffectDisplay
description: Displaying effect potion with PlaceholderAPI integration
body:
# EffectDisplay - Simple Plugin To Display Player Current Active Effect Potion

## Available Placeholder:
- %effectdisplay_effects% - Display name effect with level
- %effectdisplay_effects_names% - Display only name effect
- %effectdisplay_count% - Display number active effect
- %effectdisplay_has_<effect>% - Display true/false player has the effect

## Commands:
- /ed check - Show player current effects
- /ed version - Show plugin version
- /ed reload - Reload plugin config (effectdisplay.admin)

## Dependencies:
PlaceholderAPI - Newest Version
